summary_md: **嘉祐sushi ([@jiayou_sushi](https://x.com/jiayou_sushi/status/2116340736736346216))** built a fictional Ming-dynasty town. A Blender-scripted blockout was repainted from 331 views by local Qwen-Image, projected back and brought into Godot, taking about 7 hours on an RTX 3080 Ti with 54% of visible surfaces AI-painted. The method follows **Trompe** ([Patch-gg/trompe](https://github.com/Patch-gg/trompe)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - Patch-gg/trompe: Texture a whole game level from a gray blockout with image models: plan cameras, paint, project, bake. Real shadows, glTF out.

relevance: Local AI texturing of game levels.
